# Support

Thanks for using Opinionated Mixins! Here is where to get help.

## Questions and usage help

- Read the [documentation](https://hasansezertasan.github.io/opinionated-mixins).
- Search the [existing issues](https://github.com/hasansezertasan/opinionated-mixins/issues) —
  your question may already be answered.
- Ask open-ended questions in
  [GitHub Discussions](https://github.com/hasansezertasan/opinionated-mixins/discussions).

## Reporting bugs and requesting features

Open an [issue](https://github.com/hasansezertasan/opinionated-mixins/issues/new/choose)
using the template that best fits your report.

## Reporting a security issue

**Do not** open a public issue for security problems. Follow the private
disclosure process in [`SECURITY.md`](SECURITY.md).

## Contributing

See [`CONTRIBUTING.md`](CONTRIBUTING.md) for how to set up a development
environment and submit changes.
